answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and let peers slash that stake when they prove fake activity. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge: it may only take small jobs until its stake and history grow, so one identity cannot become an ocean of fake accounts overnight. Each account costs real capital, and a sparrow-sized Sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes, losing them all when one is caught, which makes large-scale forgery unprofitable.
